fonts.display: 'defaultFont', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Cap Sans (custom geometric sans, similar to General Sans or Inter Display)', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Signal Blue
palette.role: Primary brand accent — links, active nav indicators, icon highlights, the inner play-button of the product mockup. Saturated enough to be the one color users remember, restrained enough to never compete with copy

palette.name: Action Blue
palette.role: Filled CTA buttons (Upgrade to Cap Pro), focus rings, and the strongest interactive state. One shade deeper than Signal Blue to give pressed actions a subtle weight shift

palette.name: Ink Black
palette.role: Headings, body text, the dark CTA button fill (Download for free). Off-black rather than pure #000 to avoid harsh edges on white

palette.name: Carbon
palette.role: Pure black reserved for the highest-emphasis text and icon fills where maximum contrast is required

palette.name: Paper
palette.role: Page and card canvas — the dominant surface across the entire site. Near-white, not pure white, to soften the reading field

palette.name: Mist
palette.role: Secondary surface for subtle differentiation — the segmented control track, inset highlights, and muted button backgrounds

palette.name: Fog
palette.role: Hairline borders on cards, buttons, and the nav bar. The structural divider of the design system

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Borders and dividers at the lowest visual layer; also appears as a subtle backdrop wash behind the footer card

palette.name: Steel
palette.role: Mid-gray for secondary icon strokes and placeholder-like elements that should recede but remain visible

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Muted captions, helper text, and de-emphasized UI labels.

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Button text on light surfaces, tertiary metadata text. One step deeper than Graphite for buttons that need a touch more presence

palette.name: Outlined Indigo
palette.role: Violet accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis.

palette.name: Spark Violet
palette.role: Violet text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases

palette.name: Spark Violet Soft
palette.role: Lighter violet companion to Spark Violet for secondary decorative strokes and gradient endpoints

palette.name: Ember
palette.role: Orange text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases.

palette.name: Sky
palette.role: Icon stroke variant within the mode selector — the paired companion to Ember for the three-mode icon set

palette.name: Ice
palette.role: Tinted blue surface wash — a barely-perceptible cool tint used for soft highlight backgrounds and the outer glow ring on the product mockup play button

palette.name: Cyan Glow
palette.role: Bright cyan accent for the glow/shadow halo behind the play button overlay in the product mockup

palette.name: Alert Red
palette.role: Red wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

palette.name: macOS Red
palette.role: Red wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

palette.name: macOS Yellow
palette.role: Yellow wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

palette.name: macOS Green
palette.role: Green wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color
